args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which caused the nightly build to fail since `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding.
- Updated the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` per FIN-212.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/bankers-rounding-fin212` — passed.
